candidates.target_behavior: Two sequential Streamable HTTP MCP server instances on one event loop both complete initialize responses; shutdown state from the first instance must not cancel the second response.
verification_method: Use an isolated temporary checkout fixed at 9972c21aa42054fb1450c5fc614761ed11847ec6.
Run the published two-restart reproducer with Uvicorn 0.52.4 and sse-starlette 3.4.11, recording both initialize outcomes and AppStatus.should_exit.
Run the same oracle with sse-starlette 3.0.2 as a dependency-version control.
Run the 3.4.11 case with the published diagnostic reset control only to test causality; do not treat the reset as a proposed production fix.
Pass criterion for a future correction: both sequential initializations return complete HTTP/SSE bodies without manual global-state reset, and the relevant existing transport tests remain green.

existing_results.author_reported: The issue reports incomplete SSE bodies on mcp 2.2.0 and 1.30.0, with failures increasing under CPU contention and repeated server restarts.
existing_results.independently_reported: A new public experiment reports that sse-starlette 3.4.11 fails on the second initialization, while 3.0.2 and a diagnostic reset of AppStatus.should_exit succeed under the same restart setup.
existing_results.falsification_result: A separate final-send ordering patch repaired a controlled plain-SSE interleaving but did not repair the actual MCP restart failure; that hypothesis is therefore excluded for this narrow task.
